lines: Status 284, 1:01 PM MT Nov 28. One thing asked of you: Preview 13 is attached, the prompt opening alone with sound, 14.3 seconds. Does the typing sound and read right now.

Heard from your message of 12:54 PM: the film is ready once the prompt part is fixed, and no more sound credits. Taken so (decision 332). Nothing more is generated, not even a test. Sound credits stand at 7,420 of 10,000: music 4,851, sound effects 2,569.

Typing speed: 14.0 characters a second before, evenly spaced. Now 19.2 a second in a hand's uneven rhythm, 84 presses in 4.3 seconds where it was 5.9. The opening is 12.8 seconds where it was 14.45. Each press plays one of Halation v2's ten key sounds, never the same one twice in a row, so the same set fits a prompt of any length. Measured from the schedule and from the preview's own frames and sound. How it sounds is unknown here until you listen. Send keeps its own sound.
Still open with you, unchanged: the two what-ifs of Preview 12 (the sand mound leaving, fall's faces going out) and the level line's mend. They stay off the film until you say yes.

Phases 0 to 5 are complete. Phase 6, the films, in four steps. One: the opening change goes to the main branch after a fresh reviewer has read it, its builder's whole report is due 2:15 PM. Two: the render handoff for your PC passed its hosted proof, 10 of 10 jobs, at 12:52 PM; after a last reading it goes to the main branch as one file to follow. Three: the 4K render runs on your PC when you start it. Four: you receive With Prompt, Without Prompt, Portfolio Looping Video and Portfolio Screenshot.

Also since 12:29 PM: the trial for the first load's lost picture on hosted Macs ended green, its answer is due 1:30 PM. Summer's air what-if is drawn at 4K and not judged yet. The lost drawing's mend has until 2:30 PM.

On the four tracks blending: an answer went to Partner. The joins can be smoothed at no credit; one song cannot be made from four tunes without new music. Nothing is built for it unless you ask. Your note that the film reads short and repetitive is logged; nothing in the picture changes without your word.
Not verified: the sound as heard, a real desktop graphics card, a phone, Safari, Firefox.
